control_device_fabrication: The device demonstrated a champion efficiency of 16.2254%, with a VOC of 0.964507 V, JSC of 24.0563 mA/cm², and FF of 69.9298%.The device achieved a champion PCE of 16.2254% with a VOC of 0.964507 V, JSC of 24.0563 mA/cm², and FF of 69.9298%. The perovskite solution (1.73 mol/L) was prepared according to chemical formula of Cs0.05MA0.16FA0.79I2.9Br0.1. The sample of MeO-4PADBC was fabricated by spin coating the MeO-4PADBC solution with a concentration of 0.33 mg/mL. Add MACl (5.0 mg/mL) as an additive was essential for stabilizing the perovskite structure. For the perovskite deposition process, the perovskite films were deposited using a two-step spin-coating process at 1000 rpm for 10 s and 5000 rpm for 30 s. 160 µL of CB was quickly poured to extract the mixed solvents at the last of 6 s. The sample underwent a controlled anneal at 110 °C for 25 min, optimizing the film’s morphological and crystalline properties.
target_device_fabrication: PSC with device efficiency (PCE) of 17.9748%, VOC of 1.07473 V, JSC of 22.1235 mA/cm², and FF of 75.5985% was obtained. The mixed perovskite (Cs0.05MA0.16FA0.79I2.9Br0.1) precursor solution was prepared with a total concentration of 1.73 mol/L in DMF/DMSO co-solvent. The incorporation of MeO-4PADBC (0.33 mg/mL) as a SAM improved morphological and electronic interfaces. The controlled addition of PSP (5.0 mg/mL) additive was implemented. Then, the perovskite precursor solution was spin-coated at 1000 rpm for 10 s, and then at 5000 rpm for 30 s. Then, 160 µL CB was dropped onto the substrate during the second spin-coating step at the last 6 s of the spin-coating. The perovskite layer was thermally conditioned at 110 °C for 25 min, consolidating its morphology.
